title: Pick cards
gridNote: Marks lg and xl, plain and tinted. The grid is one Tab stop: arrow keys move, a letter jumps to a name, Enter picks and marks the card you came from. A card on its own is one button.

kuma.why: Know when one of your sites goes down, with alerts and a status page you can share.
gitea.line: Code hosting with issues and reviews
gitea.why: A light code host of your own for private repositories.
ollama.line: Runs AI models on the computer
ollama.why: The model server that chat apps such as Open WebUI talk to.
lazygit.line: Git in a terminal, with panels
memos.why: Jot short notes from any device; they stay in one small database you own.
